import random, string

def generate_test_case():
    n = random.randint(1, 10)
    tickets = []
    current = "JFK"
    for _ in range(n):
        next_stop = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase[1:-1]) for _ in range(3))
        while next_stop == current:
            next_stop = ''.join(random.choice(string.ascii_uppercase[1:-1]) for _ in range(3))
        tickets.append([current, next_stop])
        current = next_stop
    return tickets
